ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram below shows three identical 1.0 L containers filled with the indicated amounts of gas. The stopcocks connecting the containers are originally closed and the gases are all at 25°C. Assume ideal behavior. Which gas exerts the greatest pressure?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three containers of the same shape connected by pipes with stopcocks, and the valves are shown as closed. The left container is labeled 20.0 g He, the middle container is labeled 40.0 g Ne, and the right container is labeled 30.0 g NO. The problem statement says that the three containers are all 1.0 L, the gases are all at 25°C, and they can be treated as ideal gases. Reasoning: Since the volume V of the three containers is the same and the temperature T is the same, the ideal gas equation P = nRT/V shows that pressure is proportional only to the amount of substance n. Calculate the amount of substance of each gas: the molar mass of He is about 4.00 g/mol, so n = 20.0/4.00 = 5.0 mol; the molar mass of Ne is about 20.18 g/mol, so n = 40.0/20.18 ≈ 2.0 mol; the molar mass of NO is about 30.0 g/mol, so n = 30.0/30.0 = 1.0 mol. The amount of substance of He is the largest, therefore the pressure is the largest.

raw_record.question_text: The diagram below shows three identical 1.0 L containers filled with the indicated amounts of gas. The stopcocks connecting the containers are originally closed and the gases are all at 25°C. Assume ideal behavior. Which gas exerts the greatest pressure?

method.method_draft: From the image, list the gas masses: 20.0 g He, 40.0 g Ne, and 30.0 g NO. From the text, note that the containers are identical 1.0 L vessels, stopcocks are initially closed, all gases are at 25°C, and behavior is ideal. Compute moles: He = 20.0/4.00 = 5.0 mol; Ne = 40.0/20.18 ≈ 2.0 mol; NO = 30.0/30.0 ≈ 1.0 mol. Since P = nRT/V and R, T, and V are the same for all three gases, the largest n gives the greatest pressure. Therefore He exerts the greatest pressure.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有三个相同形状的容器由带 stopcock 的管道连接，阀门显示为关闭状态。左侧容器标有 20.0 g He，中间容器标有 40.0 g Ne，右侧容器标有 30.0 g NO。题干说明三个容器都是 1.0 L，气体都在 25°C，且可按理想气体处理。
推理：由于三个容器的体积 V 相同、温度 T 相同，理想气体方程 P = nRT/V 表明压力只与物质的量 n 成正比。计算各气体的物质的量：He 的摩尔质量约为 4.00 g/mol，所以 n = 20.0/4.00 = 5.0 mol；Ne 的摩尔质量约为 20.18 g/mol，所以 n = 40.0/20.18 ≈ 2.0 mol；NO 的摩尔质量约为 30.0 g/mol，所以 n = 30.0/30.0 = 1.0 mol。He 的物质的量最大，因此压力最大。

method.method_draft: From the image, identify the mass and gas identity in each vessel: He has 20.0 g, Ne has 40.0 g, and NO has 30.0 g. From the text, use that the vessels are identical, closed, at the same 25°C, and ideal. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有三个相同形状的圆形气体容器，彼此之间由带 stopcock 的管道连接；左侧容器标有“20.0 g He”，中间容器标有“40.0 g Ne”，右侧容器标有“30.0 g NO”。题干说明三个容器都是相同的 1.0 L，stopcock 起初关闭，气体都在 25°C，并假设理想气体行为。

推理：理想气体满足 PV = nRT。因为三个容器体积相同、温度相同，且各自封闭，所以比较压力只需要比较物质的量 n。物质的量 n = m/M，因此比较 m/M：He 的摩尔质量约为 4 g/mol，20.0/4 = 5 mol；Ne 的摩尔质量约为 20 g/mol，40.0/20 = 2 mol；NO 的摩尔质量约为 30 g/mol，30.0/30 = 1 mol。He 的物质的量最大，所以在相同体积和温度下压力最大。
